name: Michael Coppola
biography: is currently an undergraduate student at Northeastern University and works as a security consultant at Virtual Security Research in Boston, MA. In past years, he won the U.S. Cyber Challenge NetWars and MIT Lincoln Lab/CSAIL CTF competitions, and is noted for finding security bugs in various Google services. His interests include memory corruption, poking at the Linux kernel, and burning things with a soldering iron. More information may be found at: Twitter: @mncoppola
